name: Coffee
summary: The drink the town is known for, black or with milk. VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 prints a wide cup range. A current cup is Check on arrival.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 10 Feb 2021 names cà phê as the drink of Buon Ma Thuot, beside the local dishes.
howToEat: VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 says cafes run from ordinary rooms to formal ones, and that a cup was 15,000 VND to nearly 100,000 VND depending on the type and the brew. Black and milk are the traditional orders. Other extractions are served and were not listed. A counter at the head of Bà Triệu serves the cup with a glass of ice cream, mixed together.

The World Coffee Museum on Nguyen Dinh Chieu is a ticketed museum, not this cup. Its ticket list prints 7:00–18:00 and its FAQ prints 8:00–17:00. An adult ticket is 150,000 VND. That is not a cafe price. A current cup is Check on arrival.
where: Cafes are dense in town. Dak Lak Tourism’s sample day uses Nguyen Chi Thanh and the garden cafes in Ako Dhong. A stall number on Bà Triệu is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Coffee in Buon Ma Thuot — black or with milk
seoDescription: Coffee, black or with milk, in a town of cafes. A 2021 article prints 15,000 VND to nearly 100,000 VND. A current cup is Check on arrival.
